description.value: Yoshi Sushi is a Japanese restaurant established in 1989, located inside Gateway Village in Victoria. It offers an extensive menu spanning traditional nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, teriyaki, tempura, and ramen, alongside party trays for takeout. Both dine-in and pickup are available, and a vegetable-focused menu section makes it accessible to non-meat-eating cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the phone number and address not present in OSM. OSM opening_hours (Tu-Fr with split lunch/dinner) conflict substantially with the website (Mon & Tue closed, Wed–Sun continuous), suggesting the OSM hours are stale. Takeout is confirmed by multiple website passages referencing pickup orders and Skip the Dishes; vegetarian options are confirmed by dedicated 'Vegetable Combinations' and 'Vegetable Dinner Box Specials' menu sections. No website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Tu-Fr 12:00-14:00, 16:30-20:30; Sa-Su 12:00-20:30) conflict with website (Mon & Tue closed, Wed–Sun 12pm–8:30pm continuous) — OSM hours appear stale.
OSM address field is empty; full address sourced from website (771 Vernon Ave #601, Victoria, BC V8X 5A7).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Yoshi Sushi is a long-established (since 1989) sit-down restaurant with takeout and vegetarian options in Victoria — a practical and welcoming food stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

Takeout.detail: Website references pickup throughout: 'Party Tray (take out only)', 'Pick up: 7:45pm' last order, 'No ice cream for pick up order'; Skip the Dishes delivery also promoted

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Vegetable Combinations' lunch section and 'Vegetable Dinner Box Specials' on dinner menu; individual vegetarian items include Agedashi Tofu, Fresh Vegetable Roll, Tempura Yam Roll, Asparagus Roll, and House Vegetable Roll
